quality_notes: The parser read the LankaLaw page linearly and produced two nodes ('12' and '4'), losing sections 1 to 3 and the section numbering; the parsed output is kept in body_as_parsed. The body was rebuilt by hand: wording from the HTML page (held, text), corrected where the Government Printer scan (page 2, read as an image) disagrees, each correction listed under corrections. The validator's numbering-gap and cross-reference warnings on the parsed body no longer apply; section 4's reference to 'section 42' is to the principal enactment.
Section 2 names the People's Bank (Special Provisions) Law, No. 25 of 1978 as an earlier amendment of section 8; that Law is not held.
The Act has four sections and no Sinhala-text clause; page 2 of the scan ends at the inserted section 42A with the printer's imprint '2-A 53858-16,000 (81/01)'.

Inserted sections 12 and 42A are carried under inserted_provisions of sections 3 and 4 (the shape parse_amendment_pdf.py uses), not as child sections, so that the Act's own numbering (1-4) is what the validator sees.
